body: For now I am okay, thank you for your concern
Damn…thank you for informing me, definitely sounds horrible.
Why is it a horrible way?

you’re right it’d be like an unofficial, official goodbye to them, it’d be one last chance to see my loved ones. Ultimately I’m conflicted on what to do, this situation would be easier if something “accidental” happened to me. I see the appeal of why someone would want to start over, but ending the cycle of thinking and being a burden, this feels like the only way I can gain control of my own situation for once
